risks.note: Tungsten, copper and other metal prices can be volatile and can affect working capital and margins; tungsten prices rose sharply (Rs.3,850/kg to Rs.18,000/kg, April 2025 to March 2026) amid China's export controls and concentrated global supply.
Aerospace and defence customers typically require extensive qualification, testing and approvals, which can lengthen the period between business development and commercial revenue.
The business requires inventory to be maintained against customer orders, particularly where raw-material prices are volatile and delivery cycles are extended.

China accounts for nearly 79% of global mined tungsten production and has introduced export controls on selected tungsten products, heightening supply-chain concerns for a company reliant on tungsten as a key input.
The proposed acquisition of Swastik Tungsten was still in process as at year-end and the facility requires refurbishment and progressive restart before contributing capacity.

- Aerospace and defence customers typically require extensive qualification, testing and approvals, which can lengthen the period between business development and commercial revenue.
- The business requires inventory to be maintained against customer orders, particularly where raw-material prices are volatile and delivery cycles are extended.
- China accounts for nearly 79% of global mined tungsten production and has introduced export controls on selected tungsten products, heightening supply-chain concerns for a company reliant on tungsten as a key input.
- The proposed acquisition of Swastik Tungsten was still in process as at year-end and the facility requires refurbishment and progressive restart before contributing capacity.
- Defence and aerospace programmes involve lengthy qualification and approval cycles, so conversion of the opportunity pipeline into revenue is expected to remain phased and may result in quarter-to-quarter variability.
- Elevated geopolitical tensions, trade fragmentation, conflict in West Asia and energy-market risks add cost and demand uncertainty for a manufacturer serving global defence and aerospace supply chains.
